system.description:
Remnants can harness their Shadow, and use it to great effect. Remnants have 10 Darkness. Darkness is refilled whenever a Remnant visits a Goddess Fountain. Remnants may also regain this Darkness by Brooding.

To perform the Brooding ability, Remnants must sit or stand alone and meditate to restore the negative energy of the Darkness. Brooding takes one hour and restores Darkness to full.
